worker_claim.report: The containment provider seam now works across service subprocesses without an environment-selected production fallback, and failed launches no longer emit completion lifecycle records.
worker_claim.summary: Added an explicit test-service composition path that injects the deterministic containment provider only in the test subprocess harness, while production composition remains cgroup-v2 based. Decoupled supervisor waiting from stricter Popen timeout behavior, added synthetic population controls for containment contract tests, and updated recovery coverage to assert cgroup retirement semantics rather than PGID wording.
